fn rs_c_label_name(stage:*CStage, chain:*RsChain)->unit {
    if chain == null(*RsChain) { trap; }
    c_text(stage, "rs_exit_");
    c_number(stage, (*chain).identity as u64);
}

fn rs_c_label(stage:*CStage, chain:*RsChain)->unit {
    rs_c_label_name(stage, chain);
    c_text(stage, ":;\n");
}

fn rs_c_goto(stage:*CStage, chain:*RsChain)->unit {
    c_text(stage, "goto ");
    rs_c_label_name(stage, chain);
    c_text(stage, ";\n");
}

fn rs_c_statement(stage:*CStage, function:*RsFunction, statement:*RmdStmt)->unit {
    if (*stage).status.failed { return; }
    if rmd_map_get(&(*function).seed_blocks, statement as usize) != null(*u8) {
        c_statement(stage, statement);
        return;
    }
    var kind:u32 = (*statement).kind;
    if kind == RMD_S_BLOCK {
        c_text(stage, "{\n");
        var child:*RmdStmt = (*statement).body;
        while child != null(*RmdStmt) {
            rs_c_statement(stage, function, child);
            child = (*child).next;
        }
        var exit:*RsExit = rmd_map_get(&(*function).exits, statement as usize) as *RsExit;
        if exit != null(*RsExit) {
            if (*exit).chain != (*exit).continuation { rs_c_goto(stage, (*exit).chain); }
            rs_c_label(stage, (*exit).continuation);
        }
        c_text(stage, "}\n");
        return;
    }
    if kind == RMD_S_RETURN || kind == RMD_S_BREAK || kind == RMD_S_CONTINUE {
        var exit:*RsExit = rmd_map_get(&(*function).exits, statement as usize) as *RsExit;
        if exit == null(*RsExit) { trap; }
        rs_c_goto(stage, (*exit).chain);
        return;
    }
    if kind == RMD_S_IF {
        var condition:usize = c_expression(stage, (*statement).expr);
        c_text(stage, "if(");
        c_value(stage, condition);
        c_text(stage, ")");
        rs_c_statement(stage, function, (*statement).body);
        if (*statement).otherwise != null(*RmdStmt) {
            c_text(stage, "else ");
            rs_c_statement(stage, function, (*statement).otherwise);
        }
        return;
    }
    if kind == RMD_S_WHILE {
        var loop:*RsLoop = rmd_map_get(&(*function).loop_targets, statement as usize) as *RsLoop;
        if loop == null(*RsLoop) { trap; }
        rs_c_label(stage, (*loop).continue_target);
        var condition:usize = c_expression(stage, (*statement).expr);
        c_text(stage, "if(!");
        c_value(stage, condition);
        c_text(stage, ")");
        rs_c_goto(stage, (*loop).break_target);
        rs_c_statement(stage, function, (*statement).body);
        rs_c_goto(stage, (*loop).continue_target);
        rs_c_label(stage, (*loop).break_target);
        return;
    }
    c_statement(stage, statement);
}

// Require complete resource exit plans and checked target nodes.
// Emit one function body without changing its input facts or cleanup plan.
fn rs_c_body(stage:*CStage, declaration:*RmdDecl, user:*u8)->bool {
    var resources:*RsStage = user as *RsStage;
    var function:*RsFunction = rmd_map_get(&(*resources).functions, declaration as usize) as *RsFunction;
    if function == null(*RsFunction) { trap; }
    c_text(stage, "{\n");
    var storage:*RmdStmt = (*function).declarations;
    if storage != null(*RmdStmt) {
        while true {
            c_statement(stage, storage);
            if storage == (*function).last_declaration { break; }
            storage = (*storage).next;
            if storage == null(*RmdStmt) { trap; }
        }
    }
    rs_c_statement(stage, function, (*function).body);
    rs_c_goto(stage, (*function).returned);
    var chain:*RsChain = (*function).chains;
    while chain != null(*RsChain) {
        if (*chain).action != null(*RsAction) {
            rs_c_label(stage, chain);
            c_statement(stage, (*(*chain).action).statement);
            rs_c_goto(stage, (*chain).next);
        }
        chain = (*chain).all_next;
    }
    rs_c_label(stage, (*function).returned);
    c_statement(stage, (*function).epilogue);
    c_text(stage, "}\n");
    return !(*stage).status.failed;
}
